title: Greek Chicken Cauliflower Rice Bowls
reject_reason: Greek herbed chicken with olives/artichoke/tomato over cauliflower rice is the same Greek chicken identity as live slow-cooker-greek-chicken-bowls / chicken-souvlaki-rice-bowls and the batch-sibling Greek rice bowl; cauliflower-rice swap is a low-carb re-plating, not a new dinner.
